provenance: Captured from pre-Crown v0.5.1 paths.ts and math.ts in Sites git history, not regenerated from current source. Every level matched its original v0.6 Crown SHA256 before capture.

waves.lesson: Find a long line along the high curl. Anchor a drone to keep it firing.
Barges need sustained fire. Reinforce a useful angle or improve a short crossing.
The lower coil is open. Keep your first line and add coverage for the second gate.
Wisps weave off the ribbon. Compare a wider Sweep with an overlapping Pierce line.
Hold both gates. Recall a weak placement or fan the lattice to cover a gap.
Establish a line on the compact dive before the other gates open.
Watch the heights: the wide loop crosses above itself.

continuation.lesson: Wisps take the middle coil while Shards circle the wide loop. A delayed dive burst arrives after both gates are busy.
Barges now use the compact dive as well as the middle coil. Give these short approaches sustained fire; wide-loop Wisps are the diversion.
The wide convoy comes first. Dive traffic follows, then a second push takes the middle coil. Hold broad coverage without abandoning the short route.

waves.lesson: Follow the inner ring to its inward exit. A beam can cover more than one arc.
The outer ring is active. Its tilt changes which lines can reach both routes.

continuation.lesson: The inner gate opens first, then the outer answers. Drifting escorts follow each burst: check both inward exits before committing the lattice.
Armored convoys travel both rings together. Wide-loop Wisps test the edge of your coverage while Barges need long contact on the inward approaches.
Both gates send mixed traffic, then late Wisps follow the convoys. Keep the shared lines working and use a dedicated line where an inward exit is exposed.

waves.lesson: Start with damage: two drones are funded. The dive opens first. The carrier will use the wide figure-eight in wave 3.
Try Stasis where routes meet in 3D. Its amber highlight marks time gained, not damage. Keep enough firing lines to stop these escorts.
Carrier inbound on the wide figure-eight: 486 hull, 40 core on breach. Hold a long firing line there while escorts use the dive and middle coil.
